rows.note: Use this colloquial choice when emphasizing that a person has a large, muscular build rather than describing a structure or stressing athletic leanness.

example.english: His friend is really well-built, with muscles all over.
example.traditional: 佢個朋友好大隻，成身都係肌肉。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go3 pang4 jau5 hou2 daai6 zek3 seng4 san1 dou1 hai6 gei1 juk6

rows.note: Choose this when you specifically mean a muscular, athletic physique, especially in a descriptive or slightly formal context.

example.english: That athlete is well-built and already looks impressive standing at the side of the field.
example.traditional: 嗰位運動員身形健碩，企喺場邊已經好有氣勢。
example.jyutping: go2 wai6 wan6 dung6 jyun4 san1 jing4 gin6 sek6 kei5 hai2 coeng4 bin1 ji5 ging1 hou2 jau5 hei3 sai3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something solidly constructed or for a person with a firm, fit-looking body.

example.english: This table is well-built, so it can hold heavy things without a problem.
example.traditional: 呢張枱做得好結實，點擺重嘢都唔怕。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 ci4 zou6 dak1 hou2 git3 sat6 dim2 baai2 cung5 je5 dou1 m4 paa3
